Notification permission not granted: the alarm will still sound, but the reminder and its Stop button can\'t appear in the notification shade. Please allow notifications in system settings.

About: while monitoring is on, the app keeps a persistent notification and resumes automatically after reboot or when a charger is plugged in.

If your phone aggressively kills background apps (e.g. MIUI/HyperOS, EMUI, ColorOS), please allow Auto-start and Background running for this app in system settings.

The alert follows the system Alarm volume. If nothing sounds at the threshold, check that the alarm volume isn't at 0 and that Do Not Disturb allows alarms.
